description: This script automates database migration creation by comparing current database schema with a Prisma schema, generating SQL migration files if changes are detected.

classes.name: Postgresql
classes.description: A class from the testing.postgresql module used to create temporary PostgreSQL instances.

methods.name: create_migration
methods.description: Creates a new database migration SQL file by comparing the current database state with the Prisma schema, generating a diff, and saving it if changes are detected.
